design_issues.screen: Data Cabang - Tambah/Edit modal with MapPicker
issues: Leaflet MapContainer triggers 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' which the CRA dev overlay treats as an Uncaught runtime error and displays a full-screen red overlay. This is non-blocking in production builds (webpack dev overlay only) but obstructs subsequent UI clicks during dev/automation. Recommend: (a) suppress ResizeObserver benign error via a window 'error' listener in index.js, or (b) wrap Leaflet resize in requestAnimationFrame/debounce, or (c) disable CRA overlay in dev via FAST_REFRESH-compatible patch. Impact during Playwright: after cabang save, the trash-row delete click was intercepted by the overlay in one run.

action_items: Suppress benign ResizeObserver loop error emitted by react-leaflet so the CRA dev overlay does not blank the screen (production is unaffected).
critical_code_review_comments: DataCabang computeCabangId derives the prefix from digits of the guru's id_guru (slice(-2) of GUR-#### -> last 2 digits). For GUR-0006 this yields G06 which happens to match ordinal 6, but for GUR-0010+ the last two digits become 10, so the code becomes G10 while it may look like a natural G10 label. Only cosmetic — pattern regex G\d{2}-CB-\d{2} still matches. Consider using an explicit guru sequence field or the full 4-digit code (G0006-CB-01) if scale >99 gurus is expected.
Sequence numbering (rows.filter(guru_id).length + 1) is race-prone for concurrent creates in both DataCabang and DataGuru — same caveat as prior iteration; move to backend if concurrency matters.

FileUpload stores images as base64 data URLs inside MongoDB documents; a single 4MB image (limit) inflates the doc ~5.4MB after base64. Multiple such docs will hit MongoDB's 16MB document limit for `guru` collection and slow /api/guru list responses drastically. Recommend moving to object storage or GridFS.
